text:
Sharing economy refers to "peer-to-peer-based activities of obtaining, giving, or sharing the access to goods and services, coordinated through community-based online services." Uber and AirBnB represent two famous examples of the sharing economy.
(1) What are the major challenges for the sharing economy? (12%)
(2) Please select one challenge that you just answer in (1) and describe (or develop) an information system/technology solution to address this challenge. (13%)
